noninvertible_encoder.conclusion: H=f(X) only implies data processing inequality; equality requires a sufficient/invertible encoding.

general_chain_identity.conclusion: Use I(Y;H)=I(Y;C)+I(Y;H|C)-I(Y;C|H). The capacity UPPER BOUND survives by dropping the nonnegative last term; an equality need not hold.

teacher_vs_self.conclusion: A gold-conditioned teacher can provide target information absent from I; a fixed model using only I and independent randomness cannot. This does not rule out computational/optimization benefits.

scope: Exact enumerated toy distributions; not a theorem of 3D generation, measured model behavior or evidence about real-user preferences.
